expression.description: Artificial gene-level RNA values and declared sample reference-genome identifiers. No actual RNA experiment, source sample genotype, transcript sequence, detection calibration, protein abundance or functional partnership is claimed. The gene identifier is a retained genomic annotation label; the episode must establish its correspondence.

genomic_source.source_region_basis: Original ACCESSION line REGION field in the retained file.
genomic_source.scope: Supplied reference window, not a new complete-genome acquisition or verification of the expression samples.

dependence: Both declared expression conditions reuse one synthetic table and gene label. Genomic parsing, selected-locus translation and correspondence reuse the same retained genomic record. These representations and calculations are not independent experimental confirmations.
